titulo: The preterite combined with cuando + the imperfect
subtitulo: Cuando me bañaba, sonó el teléfono: one action interrupts another.
regla: An action in progress (cuando + imperfect) is interrupted by a new action (preterite): cuando me bañaba, sonó el teléfono.

bloques.texto: Use the **preterite** for a **new action** in the past that **interrupts** another action that was already happening. The action in progress goes in the **imperfect**, usually after **cuando**.
The imperfect sets the scene, the thing already going on. The preterite is the event that bursts in.
The order can flip: **Sonó el teléfono cuando me bañaba.**
Tip: imperfect is the movie playing; preterite is the doorbell.

lista.en: When I was taking a shower, the phone rang.
As Elisa was walking into the classroom, she fell.
When we were coming back from the market, we had an accident.

lista.es: Cuando ==comían== en ese restaurante, la policía ==detuvo== a un ladrón.
lista.en: When they were eating at that restaurant, the police arrested a thief.

lista.es: Cuando ==remaba== al pico, ==llegó== la serie más grande.
lista.en: When I was paddling out, the biggest set came in.
